Request and hold the non-default SIM network without changing the default data SIM. Concurrency depends on the device, system and carrier, and may increase battery and data usage. Stopping releases this activation request; app routing may still keep the channel alive.
Two active SIMs must be identified. Activation is unavailable if discovery fails or is unsupported.
Request mode leaves dual-SIM properties unchanged. Compatibility mode temporarily changes a system property and restores it on normal stop. No automatic start at boot.
